integrity: Analytic proofs, explicit Gaussian covariance normalization and a separate finite diagnostic program are provided. No independent audit or historical-priority certification is claimed.
limitations: Unit-radius coordinate-plane disks, uniform ambient Euclidean directions, unweighted connected graphs. The explicit finite law concerns the first two moments. The two distributional limits concern paths and stars, and the lower-edge asymptotic concerns the star limiting distribution only.
title: Exact width-variance rigidity and a logarithmic star limit for graphical discotopes
